name: Weaver Nervous System v6 (parallel cognition mesh)

nodes.name: 1. Input Gateway
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/weaver-input — accepts only weaver-headless-n8n-v1. Returns a strict public success or rejection contract.

nodes.name: 2. Sanitize
nodes.notes: Exact-key v1 contract gate with strict bounds, correlation echo, 115s deadline, and metadata-only rejection.

nodes.name: 3. Error Gate
nodes.notes: TRUE=error→DLQ. FALSE=valid→continue pipeline.

nodes.name: DLQ Logger
nodes.notes: Metadata-only dead-letter envelope; raw input and codebase context are discarded.

nodes.name: 4. Fracture+Gate
nodes.notes: Liquid Fracture: prob-field weights (SMOOTHING=0.1), exact PHI angles, quantum state bias from Nexus_Vault

nodes.name: 6a. Self-Check
nodes.notes: Optional self-inspection. TRUE → fetch workflow & hash. FALSE → skip.

nodes.name: 6b. Self-Inspect
nodes.notes: Sandbox-safe descriptor; full drift, graph, expression, and syntax validation occurs during deployment.

nodes.name: 6c. Repo Gate
nodes.notes: Gate for repo introspection

nodes.name: 6d. Repo Peek
nodes.notes: Reads a capped snippet from repo path_glob; safe, size-limited

nodes.name: 6e. Code Search
nodes.notes: Searches codebase for search_query; returns up to 10 files with matches

nodes.name: 5. Expert Fanout
nodes.notes: Starts Logic, Emotion, Memory, Creativity, and Vigilance concurrently.

nodes.name: 5f. Expert Barrier
nodes.notes: Append-mode synchronization barrier; waits for all five expert branches.

nodes.name: 5g. Expert Assembly
nodes.notes: Allowlist-merges synchronized expert results and emits parallel latency/error telemetry.

nodes.name: 8c. Local Barrier
nodes.notes: Waits for LoRA voice and Qwen routing branches before deterministic fusion.
